units.source_text: 过不多久，我抱着意外的心情，抬头仰望道子养父的身影。

en.t: Before long, in a state of surprise, I looked up at the figure of Michiko's adoptive father.

units.source_text: 我脑海里旋即浮现出两个词：院政时代的山法师和秃头的大汉。

en.t: Two phrases immediately came to mind: a warrior monk from the cloistered government era, and a bald giant of a man.

units.source_text: 这大和尚身材魁梧，却非常耳背。

en.t: This great monk was powerfully built, but he was extremely hard of hearing.
